messages:
rachel: emergency cuteness alert  surprise: meet Sir Prickles, my rescue hedgehog, participating in his first Zoom cameo. video: https://imgur.com/a/SirPricklesZoom :sparkles:
omar: is that a tiny bow tie?? international incident. :bowtie: :joy:
tess: i did not know hedgehogs were allowed to be so dignified and also furious about cucumbers. :angry: :cucumber:
mike: question: how does one pronounce "hedgehog" in the royal accent? hedg-eh-hog? :thinking:
rachel: it's mostly huffs and the occasional wheel-of-doom sprint. bow tie is elastic-free craft band. moral support only, no cucumbers in his presence. :smile:
hedgy-bot: Reminder: small critter office checklist: temp stable, closed containers for snacks, no loud music. https://redwood.example.com/pet-guidelines :information_source:
omar: posted still: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T22222-F33333/sir_prickles_bowtie.jpg
tess: caption submission: "Sir Prickles, Keeper of Quiet Judgments" :trophy:
mike: poll time: what should his official Slack title be? react with :one: "Chief Needle Officer", :two: "Lord of the Wheel", :three: "Sultan of Snooze"
(reactions: rachel :one:, omar :two:, tess :three:)
rachel: oh these are all excellent. also note he prefers chin scratches, not head pets. please respect the spiky boundaries. :handshake:
omar: also: anyone have hedgehog lore? apparently they like warm socks? :socks:
tess: rumor: hedgehogs do a dramatic curl when embarrassed. proof required. :video_request:
hedgy-bot: Automated note: Please register exotic pets via the People Ops portal before in-person appearances: https://redwood.example.com/pets-register
mike: i will bring a miniature throne (cardboard) to the micro-showcase just in case. must be ceremonial. :performing_arts:
rachel: he started snuggling the bow tie at the end of the clip. heart exploded. will drop a follow-up pic tomorrow of Sir Prickles napping in a tiny teacup. :cup_with_straw:
